title: Rehydrating and Resuspending Primers in Solution
author: Hieu Nguyen

steps.title: Place dried primer in tube
steps.instruction: Place the dried primer into a vial or tube if it is not already present.

steps.title: Centrifuge primer tube
steps.instruction: Insert the vial/tube containing the dried primer into a centrifuge.

steps.title: Add water to rehydrate
steps.instruction: For each nanomole (nmol) of primer, add 10 µL of water to make the stock solution.

steps.title: Prepare working solution
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the stock solution and mix it with 90 µL of buffer.

steps.title: Remove tube from centrifuge
steps.instruction: Stop the centrifuge and carefully remove the vial/tube without mixing up the primer.

steps.title: Store stock solution
steps.instruction: Store the stock solution for later use.

steps.title: Record primer amount
steps.instruction: Record the nanomoles of the primer from the documentation.
